title: Who is the Jesus of Adventism?
description:
In Matthew 24, Jesus warned that many "false christ's" would go out into the world. The Christian Church has stood firm on the foundation that Jesus Christ is God Almighty—alongside the Father and the Holy Spirit—for 2000 years. This is a cardinal doctrine of the Christian faith and departing from this ancient and biblical belief puts one outside the bounds of Christianity.

In this series, we examine the Jesus of Seventh-Day Adventism in light of the biblical and historical Jesus Christ. Does the SDA Church proselytize the true Christ or a false Christ?
